_comment: SHARED token-estimator corpus — the single source of truth for how BOTH
clients count tokens for context budgeting.
Both suites assert EstimateTokens(text) == tokens for every case, so a
change to one implementation fails the other side's tests. If you are here
because a test failed: fix the implementation, do not edit the numbers
unless you are deliberately changing the model on BOTH sides at once.
The model (see token_estimator.go): count CODE POINTS, not UTF-16 units.
dense script: ceil(2n / 3)   i.e. ~1.5 chars per token
non-empty text never estimates below 1 token; empty text is 0.
Dense scripts are Thai (U+0E00-0E7F), CJK (U+4E00-9FFF), Kana
Per-message framing (+4), tool-call overhead (+8) and the image-block
constant are NOT part of this corpus — it pins text estimation only.

cases.name: empty
cases.note: Empty text is the only input that may estimate 0.

cases.name: single_ascii_char
cases.note: floor(1/4) = 0, raised to the 1-token floor for non-empty text.

cases.name: pure_ascii
cases.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

cases.name: pure_thai
cases.text: สวัสดีครับ ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก
cases.note: 27 Thai + 1 space. The case the flat 4-chars/token model undercounted ~2.7x.

cases.name: mixed_thai_ascii
cases.text: ราคา API อยู่ที่ 100 บาทต่อเดือนครับ
cases.note: 26 Thai + 10 latin — the realistic shape of SRAN conversations.

cases.name: thai_numerals_and_punctuation
cases.note: Thai digits U+0E51-0E53 are inside the Thai block, so they count as dense.

cases.name: thai_long_paragraph
cases.text: ระบบนี้ใช้สำหรับจัดการข้อมูลลูกค้าและออกใบเสนอราคาให้อัตโนมัติ ผู้ใช้สามารถกำหนดสิทธิ์การเข้าถึงได้ตามบทบาทของแต่ละแผนก
cases.note: Realistic Thai paragraph: 118 Thai + 1 space = 79 tokens, versus 30 under the old flat 4-chars/token model — the 2.6x gap in one message.

cases.name: emoji
cases.note: REGRESSION GUARD: 4 astral emoji are 4 code points but 8 UTF-16 units. An implementation that walks UTF-16 chars reports 4 here instead of 3.

cases.name: cjk
cases.note: 14 dense runes; U+3001 is outside the dense ranges, so the two are latin-counted.

cases.name: fullwidth_forms
cases.note: 8 fullwidth runes are dense; U+3000 ideographic space is not in the ranges.

cases.name: code_snippet_latin
cases.note: Code is latin-dense in practice; the estimator makes no special case for it.

cases.name: thai_with_url
cases.text: ดูรายละเอียดที่ https://sran.ai/docs/pricing ครับ
cases.note: Mixed real-world message: 19 Thai runes of prose around a 30-character latin URL.
